support: Full frozen FOV, including U, same as original global Dice/Precision/FP; mask before skeletonization
skeleton: skimage skeletonize(method=zhang), native 2D; zero outside FOV, no GT/pred repair or additional tolerance

definitions.clDice: harmonic mean of these two ratios

empty: Ratios with denominator zero are NA; clDice=1 for both masks empty, 0 if only one is empty, 0 if both nonempty ratios sum to zero; counts and flags kept. Authors raw code has no empty guards.
aggregation: per-image ratios, then equal image macro; pooled counts separately labeled; no pixel-as-independent intervals
bootstrap: Reuse original 1000x28 paired image indices; conditional on one trained seed and reused Dev
authors_code_note: Published metric local variable names tprec/tsens are reversed versus paper Eq1, but harmonic mean unchanged; report follows paper definitions.
FP_partition: New FP: GT distance<=1; or GT distance>1 and added 8-component touches A0 prediction; or GT distance>1 and added component does not touch A0 prediction. Geometry, NOT medical mechanism classes.
false_centerline: S(P) outside GT: label-relative skeleton error, not a verified fake anatomical vessel or wrong connection.
predicted_margin: 2*EDT(P) at same GT skeleton coordinates covered by all three models; local support margin proxy, not clinical diameter.
